name: com.invertlab.spriteanimator
description: Portable DOTS-first 2D flipbook sprite animation with timeline authoring, events, sockets, and Query/Unity2D colliders. Unity Physics (Character body + OverlapAabb) is optional via com.unity.physics.

samples.description: All integration samples: Playback API, Events, Sockets, Crowd GPU, Collider Query, Collider Unity 2D Events, Unity Physics, and Showcase (Clembod). Import once to get everything.
Self-contained CPU/GPU playback demo; no optional input or physics dependencies.
